gold_reason: The pause in the West Asia crisis has reduced inflation risk, making gold a more attractive investment

lead_story: The easing of Middle East tensions has led to a decline in oil prices and a decrease in Treasury yields, which has improved investor sentiment and boosted stock markets. The Federal Reserve is now under pressure to adjust interest rates in response to the changing economic landscape. As a result, Fed Chairman Warsh is facing an inflation credibility test after recent Congress hearings.
